0001: #!/usr/bin/env python3
0002: """Original-compiler toolchain for the decomp track.
0003: 
0004: `original-code`, .comment of the shipped ELF (in link order):
0005:   [0x00] GCC 4.4.6 (Red Hat 4.4.6-4)   glibc crt objects, merged by ld
0006:   [0x2c] GCC 4.4.7 (Red Hat 4.4.7-3)   every game object, merged by ld
0007:   61 x   GCC 4.1.2 (Red Hat 4.1.2-51)  prebuilt static-library objects from an
0008:                                       assembler that did not mark .comment mergeable
0009: Game code also shows GCC >= 4.4 features: `[clone .clone.N]` (IPA-CP) and direct
0010: `__cxa_atexit(dtor)` registration. We therefore fetch exactly gcc 4.4.7-3.el6 with
0011: binutils 2.20.51.0.2-5.36.el6 and the CentOS 6.4 glibc/kernel headers from the
0012: CentOS vault, plus the pinned OGRE 1.6.5 archive for its headers. Everything is
0013: extracted into a cache directory whose path must not contain spaces (the GCC
0014: driver composes sub-commands from specs).
0015: 
0016:     python3 tools/decomp/toolchain.py setup
0017:     python3 tools/decomp/toolchain.py cc decomp/src/RunicCore.cpp -o /tmp/x.o
0018:     python3 tools/decomp/toolchain.py cc FILE -S -o FILE.s
0019: """

0030: import sys
0031: import tarfile
0032: import tempfile
0033: import urllib.request

0036: CONFIG = ROOT / "decomp" / "config.json"
0037: VAULT = "https://vault.centos.org/6.4/os/x86_64/Packages/"

0050:     "glibc-headers-2.12-1.107.el6.x86_64.rpm": "183fc4f18598e6c4eac5c75e3299a9fafb3468ea36eab6acea365104d8e3cbf1",
0051:     "glibc-devel-2.12-1.107.el6.x86_64.rpm": "f0162adeb816f1f111000a48112fef828876e44114fd5b396f7b59e9b3632621",
0052:     "kernel-headers-2.6.32-358.el6.x86_64.rpm": "cb79b7c214402c80dc4e579a19e8ca235faf8b93b958d95cca15e1f473b4595a",
0053:     "binutils-2.20.51.0.2-5.36.el6.x86_64.rpm": "a8dfefada3011c0f1631a1cafab3ddb766fd0151d9815ab13f372188cb1c0523",

0055: # Same archive and digest as third_party/ogre-1.6.5-math/source-inputs.json.
0056: OGRE = ("ogre-v1-6-5.tar.bz2",
0057:         "https://sourceforge.net/projects/ogre/files/ogre/1.6.5/ogre-v1-6-5.tar.bz2/download",
0058:         "7fc0e948679c1c1f10751756d267a41d0e3395a6520a23f7853a0ae39a1281f5")
0059: GCC_TRIPLE = "x86_64-redhat-linux"
0060: GCC_VERSION = "4.4.7"
0061: EXPECTED_COMMENT = "GCC: (GNU) 4.4.7 20120313 (Red Hat 4.4.7-3)"

0063: 
0064: def cache_dir():
0065:     base = Path(os.environ.get("OTL_DECOMP_CACHE", Path.home() / ".cache" / "opentorchlight" / "decomp"))
0066:     if " " in str(base):
0067:         raise SystemExit(f"OTL_DECOMP_CACHE must not contain spaces: {base}")
0068:     return base
0069: 
0070: 
0071: def sha256(path):
0072:     h = hashlib.sha256()
0073:     with open(path, "rb") as stream:
0074:         for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(1 << 20), b""):
0075:             h.update(chunk)
0076:     return h.hexdigest()
0077: 
0078: 
0079: def fetch(url, target, digest):
0080:     if target.exists() and sha256(target) == digest:
0081:         return target
0082:     target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
0083:     tmp = target.with_suffix(target.suffix + ".part")
0084:     print(f"fetch {url}")
0085:     with urllib.request.urlopen(url) as response, open(tmp, "wb") as out:
0086:         shutil.copyfileobj(response, out)
0087:     actual = sha256(tmp)
0088:     if actual != digest:
0089:         tmp.unlink()
0090:         raise SystemExit(f"checksum mismatch for {url}: {actual}")
0091:     tmp.rename(target)
0092:     return target
0093: 
0094: 
0095: def setup():
0096:     cache = cache_dir()
0097:     downloads = cache / "downloads"
0098:     root = cache / "gcc447"
0099:     stamp = root / ".complete.json"
0100:     expected = {"rpms": RPMS, "ogre": OGRE[2]}
0101:     if stamp.exists() and json.loads(stamp.read_text()) == expected:
0102:         print(f"toolchain ready: {root}")
0103:         return
0104:     if root.exists():
0105:         shutil.rmtree(root)
0106:     root.mkdir(parents=True)
0107:     for name, digest in RPMS.items():
0108:         rpm = fetch(VAULT + name, downloads / name, digest)
0109:         cpio = subprocess.run(["rpm2cpio", str(rpm)], check=True, capture_output=True).stdout
0110:         subprocess.run(["cpio", "-idmu", "--quiet"], input=cpio, cwd=root, check=True,
0111:                        capture_output=True)
0112:     archive = fetch(OGRE[1], downloads / OGRE[0], OGRE[2])
0113:     ogre = root / "ogre-1.6.5"
0114:     with tarfile.open(archive) as tar:
0115:         members = [m for m in tar.getmembers()
0116:                    if m.name.startswith(("ogre/OgreMain/include/", "ogre/COPYING"))
0117:                    and ".." not in m.name]
0118:         tar.extractall(ogre, members=members, filter="data")
0119:     stamp.write_text(json.dumps(expected, sort_keys=True))
0120:     check = compile_source(None, None, probe=True)
0121:     print(f"toolchain ready: {root}\n  {check}")
0122: 
0123: 
0124: def config():
0125:     return json.loads(CONFIG.read_text())
0126: 
0127: 
0128: def include_args(root, cfg):
0129:     gcc_inc = root / "usr" / "include" / "c++" / GCC_VERSION
0130:     args = ["-nostdinc", "-nostdinc++"]
0131:     for path in (gcc_inc, gcc_inc / GCC_TRIPLE, gcc_inc / "backward",
0132:                  root / "usr" / "lib" / "gcc" / GCC_TRIPLE / GCC_VERSION / "include",
0133:                  root / "usr" / "include"):
0134:         args += ["-isystem", str(path)]
0135:     for item in cfg.get("include", []):
0136:         base = Path(os.environ.get("OTL_INCLUDE_ROOT", ROOT)) if item.startswith("decomp/") else ROOT
0137:         args += ["-I", str(base / item)]
0138:     # Generated headers for work in progress (llm_loop.py); committed sources must not need them.
0139:     for item in filter(None, os.environ.get("OTL_EXTRA_INCLUDE", "").split(":")):
0140:         args += ["-I", item]
0141:     for item in cfg.get("system_include", []):
0142:         path = item.replace("@OGRE@", str(root / "ogre-1.6.5" / "ogre"))
0143:         path = path if os.path.isabs(path) else str(ROOT / path)
0144:         args += ["-isystem", path]
0145:     return args
0146: 
0147: 
0148: def driver_env(root):
0149:     env = dict(os.environ)
0150:     env["LD_LIBRARY_PATH"] = str(root / "usr" / "lib64")
0151:     env["LC_ALL"] = "C"
0152:     return env
0153: 
0154: 
0155: CC_CACHE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "build-decomp" / "cc-cache"
0156: 
0157: 
0158: def _digest(cmd, source, deps, preprocessed=None):
0159:     h = hashlib.sha256("\0".join(cmd).encode())
0160:     h.update((preprocessed or "").encode())
0161:     for path in [source, *deps]:
0162:         try:
0163:             data = Path(path).read_bytes()
0164:             h.update(str(path).encode() + b"\0" + str(len(data)).encode() + b"\0" + data)
0165:         except OSError:
0166:             return None
0167:     return h.hexdigest()
0168: 
0169: 
0170: def _preprocessed_digest(cmd, source, root):
0171:     """Resolve includes anew: adding a shadow header must invalidate an old hit."""
0172:     args = [a for a in cmd if a not in ("-c", "-S")]
0173:     result = subprocess.run(args + ["-E", str(source)], env=driver_env(root), capture_output=True)
0174:     if result.returncode:
0175:         return None
0176:     h = hashlib.sha256(result.stdout)
0177:     # Both the driver and cc1 can change without a command-line change.
0178:     for path in (Path(cmd[0]), root / "usr/libexec/gcc" / GCC_TRIPLE / GCC_VERSION / "cc1plus",
0179:                  root / "usr/bin/as"):
0180:         h.update(sha256(path).encode())
0181:     return h.hexdigest()
0182: 
0183: 
0184: def _cache_lookup(cmd, source, preprocessed=None):
0185:     """Cached output bound to current include resolution and compiler contents."""
0186:     index = CC_CACHE / (hashlib.sha256(("\0".join(cmd) + str(source)).encode()).hexdigest() + ".json")
0187:     if not index.exists():
0188:         return index, None
0189:     try:
0190:         entry = json.loads(index.read_text())
0191:         if entry.get("schema") != 2 or not preprocessed:
0192:             return index, None
0193:         digest = _digest(cmd, source, entry["deps"], preprocessed)
0194:     except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
0195:         return index, None
0196:     if digest and digest == entry["digest"] and (CC_CACHE / entry["output"]).exists():
0197:         return index, CC_CACHE / entry["output"]
0198:     return index, None
0199: 
0200: 
0201: def jobs():
0202:     """Parallel compiler processes: OTL_JOBS, by default all cores but one (at most 5)."""
0203:     if os.environ.get("OTL_JOBS"):
0204:         return max(1, int(os.environ["OTL_JOBS"]))
0205:     return max(1, min(5, (os.cpu_count() or 2) - 1))
0206: 
0207: 
0208: def parallel_map(fn, items):
0209:     """[fn(x) for x in items] on jobs() threads (the work is in compiler subprocesses), in order;
0210:     the first exception, SystemExit included, is raised after the others finish."""
0211:     items = list(items)
0212:     if jobs() == 1 or len(items) < 2:
0213:         return [fn(x) for x in items]
0214:     with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=jobs()) as pool:
0215:         futures = [pool.submit(fn, x) for x in items]
0216:     return [f.result() for f in futures]
0217: 
0218: 
0219: def compile_source(source, output, extra=(), assembly=False, probe=False, quiet=False, cache=True):
0220:     """Compile with GCC 4.4.7-3.el6 and binutils 2.20.51; returns the output path.
0221: 
0222:     Results are cached in build-decomp/cc-cache by source, dependency and flag
0223:     digests; set OTL_NO_CC_CACHE=1 or cache=False to bypass (side outputs such
0224:     as dumps are not cached)."""
0225:     root = cache_dir() / "gcc447"
0226:     if not (root / ".complete.json").exists():
0227:         raise SystemExit("toolchain missing; run: python3 tools/decomp/toolchain.py setup")
0228:     cfg = config()
0229:     gxx = root / "usr" / "bin" / "g++"
0230:     base = [str(gxx), f"-B{root}/usr/libexec/gcc/{GCC_TRIPLE}/{GCC_VERSION}/", f"-B{root}/usr/bin/"]
0231:     with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="otl-cc-") as tmp:
0232:         if probe:
0233:             source = Path(tmp) / "probe.cpp"
0234:             source.write_text("int probe(int x) { return x * 3; }\n")
0235:         out = Path(tmp) / ("out.s" if assembly else "out.o")
0236:         cmd = base + include_args(root, cfg) + list(cfg["cflags"]) + list(extra)
0237:         cmd += ["-S" if assembly else "-c"]
0238:         use_cache = cache and not probe and not os.environ.get("OTL_NO_CC_CACHE")
0239:         preprocessed = _preprocessed_digest(cmd, source, root) if use_cache else None
0240:         if use_cache:
0241:             index, hit = _cache_lookup(cmd, source, preprocessed)
0242:             if hit:
0243:                 output = Path(output)
0244:                 output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
0245:                 shutil.copyfile(hit, output)
0246:                 return output
0247:         depfile = Path(tmp) / "out.d"
0248:         cmd_full = cmd + [str(source), "-o", str(out)] + (["-MD", "-MF", str(depfile)] if use_cache else [])
0249:         result = subprocess.run(cmd_full, env=driver_env(root), capture_output=True, text=True)
0250:         if result.returncode:
0251:             if quiet:
0252:                 raise SystemExit(f"compile failed: {source}\n{result.stderr}")
0253:             sys.stderr.write(result.stderr)
0254:             raise SystemExit(f"compile failed: {source}")
0255:         if result.stderr.strip() and not quiet:
0256:             sys.stderr.write(result.stderr)
0257:         if probe:
0258:             comment = subprocess.run(["readelf", "-p", ".comment", str(out)], capture_output=True,
0259:                                      text=True).stdout
0260:             if EXPECTED_COMMENT not in comment:
0261:                 raise SystemExit(f"unexpected compiler identity:\n{comment}")
0262:             return EXPECTED_COMMENT
0263:         output = Path(output)
0264:         output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
0265:         shutil.copyfile(out, output)
0266:         if use_cache and depfile.exists():
0267:             # Make-style dependency list: "\\ " escapes spaces in paths, "\\\n" continues lines.
0268:             body = depfile.read_text().replace("\\\n", " ").split(": ", 1)[1].replace("\\ ", "\0")
0269:             deps = [d.replace("\0", " ") for d in body.split() if d.replace("\0", " ") != str(source)]
0270:             digest = _digest(cmd, source, deps, preprocessed) if preprocessed else None
0271:             if digest:
0272:                 CC_CACHE.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
0273:                 name = digest + (".s" if assembly else ".o")
0274:                 shutil.copyfile(out, CC_CACHE / name)
0275:                 partial = index.with_suffix(f".{os.getpid()}.{id(out)}.tmp")
0276:                 partial.write_text(json.dumps({"schema": 2, "deps": deps, "digest": digest, "output": name}))
0277:                 os.replace(partial, index)
0278:     return output
0279: 
0280: 
0281: def assemble(source, output):
0282:     root = cache_dir() / "gcc447"
0283:     subprocess.run([str(root / "usr" / "bin" / "as"), "--64", "-o", str(output), str(source)],
0284:                    env=driver_env(root), check=True)
0285:     return output
0286: 
0287: 
0288: def main():
0289:     parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
0290:     sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
0291:     sub.add_parser("setup")
0292:     cc = sub.add_parser("cc")
0293:     cc.add_argument("source", type=Path)
0294:     cc.add_argument("-o", "--output", type=Path, required=True)
0295:     cc.add_argument("-S", dest="assembly", action="store_true")
0296:     cc.add_argument("extra", nargs="*")
0297:     sub.add_parser("env")
0298:     args = parser.parse_args()
0299:     if args.command == "setup":
0300:         setup()
0301:     elif args.command == "cc":
0302:         print(compile_source(args.source, args.output, args.extra, args.assembly))
0303:     else:
0304:         root = cache_dir() / "gcc447"
0305:         print(json.dumps({"root": str(root), "config": config(),
0306:                           "include_args": include_args(root, config())}, indent=1))
0307: 
0308: 
0309: if __name__ == "__main__":
0310:     main()
